# dots-hyprland (personal fork)

Personal fork of [end-4/dots-hyprland](https://github.com/end-4/dots-hyprland).
This is for my own use and is not intended to be submitted upstream.

## Changes (Waffle / Windoes-style UI)

- Drag to reorder pinned apps on the taskbar and in the Start menu
  (with a live preview as you drag)
- Windows 11 style search box on the taskbar
- Removed the Widgets button; taskbar icons are now left-aligned
- Pinned apps are matched to running windows by desktop entry,
  so one app no longer shows up twice
- Japanese translation

Heads-up: the Widgets button is removed and the layout is left-aligned,
so this differs from upstream's default look.
